_about: Labels verify/derive.js gives today that are wrong, for the labels builder (branch wt-labels: derive.js the only source of labels, no hand overrides). Found by the review of the Adeptus Custodes catalogue (verify/review/result-catalog-custodes.json). data.js keeps derive.js's values until derive.js gets the general rule; the catalogue writer has no exception of its own (verify/catalog-write.js).

items.where: Adeptus Custodes · Null Maiden Vigil rule · Silent Sisterhood
items.why: first-unit takes the mustering bullet ("When mustering your army, you can select a friendly ANATHEMA PSYKANA CHARACTER model to be your WARLORD"). The rule's in-game part, Creeping Dread (Aura), is given to "Friendly ANATHEMA PSYKANA units" (derive.js's own grant reading: to {all:[Faction: Anathema Psykana]}); PROSECUTOR SQUAD (BATTLELINE) is Anathema Psykana too. With Character the rule reaches only the Knight-Centura.
items.rule: first-unit (and kw-all) skip a sentence that starts "When mustering your army": it says who can be chosen before the battle, not which units the rule reaches
items.source: data.js FACTIONS adeptus-custodes · null-maiden-vigil · rule (Wahapedia adeptus-custodes, Null Maiden Vigil 1DP)

items.where: Adeptus Custodes · Aquilan Shield rule · Gilded Guardians
items.why: GW: "ranged attacks that target that unit … have -1 to wound rolls", and Favoured ka'tah SALVUS "Your unit's ranged attacks have +6" R". Nothing of it is in the Fight phase: the generic targeted rule matched "attacks that target that unit" although the attacks are ranged (derive.js's own Additional Effect reading gives movement and shooting).
items.rule: "ranged attacks that target" is read as targeted-ranged (the opponent's Shooting phase, and Fire Overwatch in its Movement phase), not targeted

items.where: Adeptus Custodes · Shadowkeepers rule · Wardens of the Dark Cells
items.why: The mirror case of Gilded Guardians: "melee attacks that target that unit … have -1 to wound rolls", and Favoured ka'tah KAPTARIS's Additional Effect (an enemy unit engaged with your unit makes a battle-shock roll): only melee, the Fight phase.
items.rule: "melee attacks that target" is read as targeted-melee (the Fight phase), not targeted

items.why: TARGET: "One SYNAPSE unit from your army … and one enemy unit within 24" of and visible to the SYNAPSE unit": the second SYNAPSE names the same unit again; needs list it twice under any.
items.rule: a keyword named again in the TARGET ("… of the SYNAPSE unit") is the same unit, not an alternative: no duplicate, all
items.source: data.js FACTIONS tyranids (a catalogue detachment, verify/from-bsdata.js tyranids), Wahapedia tyranids

items.where: Tyranids · Vanguard Onslaught rule · Questing Tendrils
items.why: "… are eligible to charge in a turn in which they Fell Back / Advanced": the rule is used when the unit declares a charge (the Charge phase); the Fall Back and Advance are what it allows, not when it is used.
items.rule: "eligible to charge in a turn in which they …" is used in the Charge phase (the moves it names are its condition)
items.source: data.js FACTIONS tyranids (a catalogue detachment, verify/from-bsdata.js tyranids), Wahapedia tyranids

items.where: Tyranids · Warrior Bioform Onslaught rule · Leader-beasts
items.why: The rule gives keywords (TYRANID WARRIORS, BATTLELINE) and "5+ InSv": always on, no phase. derive.js reads the InSv as "targeted" (attacks against it in the opponent's Shooting phase, the Fight phase and Fire Overwatch).
items.rule: an always-on keyword or invulnerable-save grant ("have 5+ InSv", "have: KEYWORD") gives no timing label, as for an ability that protects the unit
items.source: data.js FACTIONS tyranids (a catalogue detachment, verify/from-bsdata.js tyranids), Wahapedia tyranids

items.where: Tyranids · Subterranean Assault rule · Surprise Assault
items.why: "Each time a TYRANIDS model from your army makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1." reaches every TYRANIDS unit; the later bullets (BURROWER units, MAWLOC/TRYGON) are parts of the same rule for some of them, not alternatives to TYRANIDS.
items.rule: the rule's first unit keyword with "from your army" decides needs; later bullets naming narrower keywords are parts, not an any
items.source: data.js FACTIONS tyranids (a catalogue detachment, verify/from-bsdata.js tyranids), Wahapedia tyranids
